class.name: Entity3DGizmo
class.brief_description: Abstract class to expose editor gizmos for [Entity3D].
class.description: This abstract class helps connect the [Entity3D] scene with the editor-specific [EditorEntity3DGizmo] class. [Entity3DGizmo] by itself has no exposed API, refer to [method Entity3D.add_gizmo] and pass it an [EditorEntity3DGizmo] instance.
